verdict.rationale: GitHub's own mobile page says Agent Tasks on GitHub Mobile give developers "a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks", letting them start new tasks, track progress, and view a task list. Users can also assign issues to Copilot, then refine, approve and merge the resulting PRs in the app. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Agent Tasks feature, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing copy (e.g., detail on task status, logs, or stopping or steering tasks).
